Data:Scales.spice.json.Label: Spice Scales
Data:Scales.spice.json.Desc: Redolent of decades of piquant pesage.

Data:Sceptical.json.label: Sceptical
Data:Sceptical.json.desc: Trust can be bought, or earned.

Data:Scraps.wood.json.Label: Wooden Scraps
Data:Scraps.wood.json.Desc: Scraps of wood. Possibly useful as fuel.

xexts.scrutiny: Sort through the scraps… nothing of use.

Data:Scroll.json.label: Scroll
Data:Scroll.json.desc: A book with a very long page.

Data:Sea.holly.json.Label: Sea Holly
Data:Sea.holly.json.Desc: Umbelled spiny flowers, the steel-blue of a winter afternoon.

xexts.scrutiny: Traditionally, this was the flower of Hush House. Sometimes you find it along the dunes and cliff-tops hereabouts.

Data:Sea.release.json.label: Release
Data:Sea.release.json.startdescription: I could release it to the waves, the winds, or the sands, as it prefers.
Data:Sea.release.json.desc: There were two of us, and now there's one.

Data:Sea.renounce.journal.json.label: Renounce What Could Be
Data:Sea.renounce.journal.json.startdescription: My journal won't survive a second soaking. [THIS WILL DESTROY YOUR JOURNAL, which will make it IMPOSSIBLE TO COMPLETE THE GAME. You'll be stuck! But you can do it if you really want.]
Data:Sea.renounce.journal.json.desc: Does anything happen? Does an arm in white samite rise from the sea to accept the book? No. Only the water lapping on the beach, and the long ripple washing, as the old knight once said... and the White Flower has triumphed. [It is no longer possible to complete the game.]

Data:Sea.renounce.json.label: Renounce
Data:Sea.renounce.json.startdescription: If I cast an object into the sea, it will be lost, perhaps irretrievably. [Use this to dispose of junk, or of danger.]
Data:Sea.renounce.json.desc: When something is given to the sea it rarely returns... although, of course, I did.

Data:Sea.renounce.penny.json.label: Renounce
Data:Sea.renounce.penny.json.startdescription: Why? Why not? [Dispose of a stray penny.]

Data:Sea.renounce.penny.numa.json.label: Renounce
Data:Sea.renounce.penny.numa.json.startdescription: To give a coin to the sea at this season - once, this was said to be the toll due to Ys. [Dispose of a stray penny.]
Data:Sea.renounce.penny.numa.json.desc: And the waves march on to the horizon.

Data:Sea.swimming.blocker.storm.json.label: Never Again
Data:Sea.swimming.blocker.storm.json.startdescription: The waves are hungry today. I'm not going swimming in a storm... well, not a second time.

Data:Sea.swimming.dry.damp.json.label: A Brisk Swim
Data:Sea.swimming.dry.damp.json.startdescription: I'll plunge again into the waves... though I have no dry towels.
Data:Sea.swimming.dry.damp.json.desc: The waves raise me; the salt stings my eyes; the horizon waits.

Data:Sea.swimming.dry.json.label: A Brisk Swim
Data:Sea.swimming.dry.json.startdescription: I'll plunge again into the waves... and dry off afterwards.
Data:Sea.swimming.dry.json.desc: The waves raise me; the salt stings my eyes; the horizon waits. Afterwards, the towels are clean and soft. [By drying off afterwards, you've gained a Memory: Solace.]

Data:Sea.swimming.hint.json.label: A Brisk Swim?
Data:Sea.swimming.hint.json.startdescription: [Swimming requires an Element of the Soul with Heart and Scale - generally, this means Health.]

Data:Sea.swimming.json.label: A Brisk Swim
Data:Sea.swimming.json.startdescription: I'll plunge again into the waves...
Data:Sea.swimming.json.desc: The waves raise me; the salt stings my eyes; the horizon waits.

slots.label: Afterwards?
slots.description: The wind will be chilly, afterwards...

Data:Sea.swimming.numa.json.label: A Brisk Swim
Data:Sea.swimming.numa.json.startdescription: I'll plunge again into the waves... though in the labyrinth season, something might be different.
Data:Sea.swimming.numa.json.desc: It is difficult afterwards to remember what I felt, there among the billows. The waves have made their pilgrimage from the horizon. Now I am a pilgrim too.

Data:Sea.swimming.winter.json.label: A Brisk Swim
Data:Sea.swimming.winter.json.startdescription: I'll plunge again into the waves... but swimming in a winter sea might be rash. [Make sure you have dry towels at the ready.]
Data:Sea.swimming.winter.json.desc: The waves raise me; the salt stings my eyes; the horizon waits.

slots.label: Afterwards?
slots.description: The wind will be chilly, afterwards...

Data:Seaglass.json.Label: Sea-Glass
Data:Seaglass.json.Desc: Smooth as an egg, frosted like a winter window.

Data:Season.pausing.json.label: Pausing Season
Data:Season.pausing.json.desc: Freeze-dry a season while we go Numa

Data:Secret.threshold.json.Label: Secret Threshold
Data:Secret.threshold.json.Desc: It's not easy to draw our own doors, but it's not impossible.

Data:Seed.json.label: Seed
Data:Seed.json.desc: A seed may grow worse in one garden than another, and better in one season than another.

Data:Serena.json.label: Dr Serena Blackwood
Data:Serena.json.desc: One-time Librarian of Hush House, one-time Librarian of the Invisible Serapeum in Alexandria, and currently... what, exactly? Serena is close-mouthed, but I know that she has worked with the St Rhonwen Trust.

Data:Serpentmilk.json.Label: Serpent-Milk
Data:Serpentmilk.json.Desc: It does look almost like milk, and it is drinkable, but don't give it to cats or babies.

xexts.scrutiny: Sssatisfying. [There are Keeper-level Edge - and perhaps Scale - recipes that can craft this from Perinculate.]

Data:Setup.cho.json.label: Memory: Chor?
Data:Setup.cho.json.desc: Chor is exuberance; instinct; rhythm. Do those mean something to me?

Data:Setup.ere.json.label: Memory: Ereb?
Data:Setup.ere.json.desc: Ereb is pride, compassion; hatred and fear. Do those passions burn in me?
